result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/gh2699-aggregate-join-restricted.md. run_query_aggregate/4 swaps its raw load_restrictions plus check_aggregate_field_restrictions/2 for FieldPolicy.check_request(principal, :aggregate, request, %{exempt?: false}); the existing walker already covers measure, group_by, filters and join hops (each governed by the hop owner entity), so no change to RequestGuard, FieldPolicy or Compiler. Deleted: check_aggregate_field_restrictions/2, aggregate_request_field_names/1, the {:aggregate_field_restricted,_} render clause (the shared guard clause in render_query_error/2 gives the same 403 and detail). Aggregate resolves all fields against the primary allowlist only, so joined-entity filter/group_by are not expressible (422, pinned by test A-7). Aggregate returns no restricted values, so no redact reuse. Nonexistent primary stays 404 with or without join (join_relations ensures primary first). Aggregate has no TypeAccess step (#2700), unchanged. T-39 allow-list removed. 17 tests, 10 mutants, ~250-350 line PR, #2612 not triggered. Open questions: Q2 (observe TypeAccess-denied aggregate status on main before pinning A-11), Q3 (unknown vs restricted distinction kept), Q1 (no TypeAccess here). AMENDED 2026-10-17 after CDV FAIL (6 gaps) and SEC conditional R1-R3: A-11 dropped (F9 documented only, Q2 closed); new A-10b (400 parse order, non-object body); M6 killed only by T-27/T-14 plus A-12 with-clause assertion; A-12 scoped to routers/entities.ex code lines only (handler_writes.ex:270 and step_writes.ex:795 also call load_restrictions, out of scope); stale comment sites listed (R6); A-6 concrete fixture with per-variant status; A-8 byte-identical bodies incl. cross-tenant; A-9 nullable fk and far-hop-only through; header fixed; PR-body items listed in section 11.
